text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Major: spike in error rate and tail latency for hosted text-generation. Smart-routing triggered fallbacks to eu-west-1 model pool, saw cascading retries. Paging oncall now.

alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 502/503s from our edge, and traffic to eu-west has doubled over the last 3 mins. client retries + failover are amplifying.

maya (sre): Confirmed. Metrics: request_rate +210%, error_rate 18% -> 55% for fallback path. KV cache hit drop to 12%. Seems wrong model-variant mapped for the fallback (we're sending 4096-L to 8k runtime).

jordan (eng-runtime): Whoa. If the fallback mapping points to a non-quantized variant on different sequence-length config that could cause OOM + retries. Pulling routing policy now.

lee (platform-ops): I see recent policy change from midnight: default_fallback: variant: stable -> variant: latest-8k. Policy commit 2026-07-14 00:12 by deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: rolled routing-policy v3.4.1 to prod at 00:12. No automated rollback.

alex (oncall): Okay we need immediate mitigation steps: 1) stop automated regional fallback to eu-west for this customer tier 2) throttle client retries at edge 3) scale up a temporary pool in primary region and pin traffic.

maya (sre): I'm going to flip the routing policy to disable auto-fallback. Applying temporary policy patch now.

jordan (eng-runtime): While you do that, add a short-circuit that returns 429 for repeated client retries above X/s to avoid thundering herd. Also enable a lightweight 503 gate with Retry-After to slow client side.

lee (platform-ops): Patch applied: routing.autofallback.enabled = false (propagating).

incident-bot: Change deployed to routing-policy flag: routing.autofallback.enabled=false by lee at 1867509800.

support-carla: Noting impacted customers: acct-429, acct-118, some smaller PLG keys. Support flagged 3 enterprise customers complaining about slow responses.

alex (oncall): I'm going to scale up primary us-west pool + add a routing override to pin affected keys to us-west for the next 30m. Jordan, can you push the override?

jordan (eng-runtime): Pushing override now:
```
POST /admin/routing/overrides
{
  "selector": "customer:acct-429,acct-118",
  "target": "us-west-1:stable-4k",
  "expires": "30m"
}
```
Applied at 1867510202.

maya (sre): I'm also rate-limiting fallback path at the load balancer: limit 200r/s with 60s burst per IP. That should cut the amplification loop.

alex (oncall): Good. Any sign of client libraries still hammering with retries? We should notify client-sdks to backoff.

support-carla: Replied to affected customers with temporary mitigation and request to disable aggressive retries on their side. Sent suggested header:
```
Retry-After: 60
X-Client-Backoff: exponential
```

jordan (eng-runtime): Runtime logs show many 429s now, and error-rate on fallback path dropping from 55% -> 22% in 4 mins. KV cache warmup is starting in us-west after override.

incident-bot: Pager cleared? No - still monitoring.

maya (sre): Setting incident priority to P1 until error_rate < 5% and latencies < SLO. Keeping page until RTT normalizes.

lee (platform-ops): I've added an emergency rule to routing policy repo to prevent picking non-quantized variants as fallback. Quick diff:
```
- fallback.variant: latest-8k
+ fallback.variant: stable-4k (quantized)
+ validation: variant.quantized == true
```
Pushed as hotfix to staging, rolling to prod in 5m.

alex (oncall): Good. Next: capture customers impacted and minutes of degraded service. Carla, collate list and timestamps. Jordan, capture heap/worker crash traces for 1867509000-1867510500. Maya, open a postmortem draft and include timeline.

support-carla: List compiled and sent to SRE+CS channel.

jordan (eng-runtime): Trace snippet:
```
[ERROR] worker-42 OOM while loading latest-8k variant (unquantized) seq=8192
stack: alloc -> kv_cache -> model_load
```
Attached to internal storage.

maya (sre): Error rate down to 8% after rate-limiting and overrides. Still seeing occasional spikes as retries decay.

alex (oncall): Alright, leaving oncall to Maya for morning. Paging handoff to maya in 15. I'll follow up with exec summary.

maya (sre): Taking over. I'll keep the routing.autofallback flag off until we validate fallback variant selection logic and add the quantized-only validation.

incident-bot: Oncall handoff: alex -> maya at 1867512600.

alex (oncall): Quick retrospective notes for postmortem: 1) policy change lacked validation guard (allowed non-quantized fallback) 2) client retry behavior + server failover produced amplification 3) lack of rate-limiting on fallback path 4) observability gaps in pre-fallback kv cache hit warning.

maya (sre): Adding remediation tasks to postmortem: enforce variant validation, add fallback throttles, improve alerts on KV cache miss spike, add canary for routing-policy changes, recommend clients adopt jittered exponential backoff.

lee (platform-ops): I'll coordinate a deploy that enforces variant.quantized == true in policy authoring UI and CLI.

support-carla: Customers updated; some reported improved performance. No escalations to legal.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'll close the page after 1h of stable metrics. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: stable -> monitoring. root_cause: routing-policy allowed non-quantized fallback + client retry amplification. next_steps: postmortem + policy validation hotfix.

maya (sre): Postmortem link (draft): https://redwood.internal/incidents/1867509123/postmortem - will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.

alex (oncall): Closing thread for now. Keep monitoring and ping if anything flares.

(End of thread)
